test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

She said, "I can come here tomorrow morning if my mother does not want me to go for shopping."

options.text: She said that she can go there the next morning if her mother did not want her to go for shopping.
She said that she could go there the following morning if her mother did not want her to go for shopping.
She said that she could go there the following morning if her mother does not want her to go for shopping.
She said that she went there the following morning if her mother does not want her to go for shopping.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she could go there the following morning if her mother did not want her to go for shopping.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I can come here tomorrow morning" becomes "She could go there the following morning"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is replaced by "she" as per the subject.
 
• Modal verb "can" changes
